test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 29 Aug 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Dev walks 23 m towards the west from his hostel gate. He takes a left turn and walks 14 m. Then he takes a right turn and walks 63 m. Then he takes a left turn and walks 32 m. He takes a left turn again and walks 86 m. Again, he takes a left turn and walks 16 m to reach a canteen. How far and in which direction is the canteen from Dev's hostel gate? (All turns are 90 degree turns only)
solution: From the given information: Dev walks 23 m towards the west from his hostel gate. He takes a left turn and walks 14 m. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8547870700c46a5ba905a8dd4debb5cfab54f53a452d52a67c3e91bded98ccfd.png] Then he takes a right turn and walks 63 m. Then he takes a left turn and walks 32 m.
